Manage rule documents.

Usage: papyrus rule [OPTIONS] [COMMAND]

Commands:
  create   Create a business rule
  list     List business rules
  view     View a business rule
  edit     Edit a business rule
  archive  Archive a business rule
  delete   Delete a business rule
  status   Set business rule status
  help     Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --json           Emit stable, machine-readable JSON.
      --dir <path>     Project directory. Default: the current working directory.
      --config <file>  Configuration file. Default: papyrus.config.yml in the project directory.
      --no-color       Disable ANSI color output.
  -h, --help           Print help
